answer: Make every newcomer pay at the river's edge. Step 1: it burns 25 POA forever and locks 200 POA in escrow, a violet stamp. Step 2: it takes small jobs, but pay stays frozen until the buyer confirms the work was real and useful. Step 3: after 10 confirmed jobs over 30 days, escrow thaws in slices; one failed check freezes the rest. Step 4: each agent is one vertex in a graph of confirmed buyers, so fakes cluster visibly. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 25,000 POA, locks 200,000 POA, and needs 10,000 real buyers no script can fake. A sybil farm is a dam on a river: every fake bucket pays the toll.
